corrections.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided WarMap Stick Pearl Harbor thumbnail artwork. Make ONE targeted correction to the Pacific background map's geographic layout. Preserve the existing big round WHITE sweating admiral on the RIGHT, his exact face, naval hat, thick black outlines, dark uniform, his hands, the large orange almost-empty barrel and last oil drop, their colors, lighting and positions. Preserve the navy overall background and the clean EMPTY top-left 40% text area. Preserve wide 16:9 full-bleed composition.
CORRECT ONLY THE BACKGROUND MAP AND ITS ARROW: Hawaii must be EAST (to the RIGHT) of Japan, not west. Remove ALL current cyan mainland and Australia/Indonesia outlines from the background, and remove the current red Japan/arrow/leftward Hawaii target. Replace them with one much simpler geographically sensible Pacific map cluster within the CENTRAL open gap behind/left of the admiral, away from the left 40% text area: small recognizable RED Japanese islands at x=44–49%, y=33–49%; small glowing ORANGE Hawaii island cluster at x=60–63%, y=50–58% (left of the admiral's face, just above the barrel edge). Draw exactly ONE clean curved red-orange arrow starting at Japan and pointing clearly RIGHT/SOUTHEAST toward the Hawaii target, with arrowhead ending at the target circle. Japan must clearly be on the LEFT of Hawaii, separated by open navy ocean. Keep arrow relatively compact so it doesn't cross the character or oil barrel or invade the left text space. No continental outlines are needed. Islands and arrow are a secondary background cue; face and barrel stay dominant.
NO TEXT, letters, numbers, captions, map labels, watermarks, logos or UI. No extra objects or characters. Do not change the admiral or barrel. Flat clean cartoon graphics consistent with existing image. Output one landscape 16:9 PNG artwork.
